test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). R is sitting to the immediate left of P and immediate right of T. Q is sitting to the immediate left of T. U is sitting to the immediate left of Q. P is sitting to the immediate left of S. Who is sitting to the immediate right of S?
solution:
Given:

P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) R is sitting to the immediate left of P and immediate right of T.

2) Q is sitting to the immediate left of T.

3) U is sitting to the immediate left of Q.

4) P is sitting to the immediate left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/522cccc797565be02df3f39d25e52017f80490627df5e21664611e5e75cf1daa.png] 

So, 'U' is sitting to the immediate right of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
